findings.discriminator: Every stale slot fires in the 05:00-09:30 UTC weekday morning band. Every fresh slot fires 13:00-20:30 UTC or on a weekend. The crons themselves are correct and matched cleanly at drift 0 this tick, so this is not a scheduling defect — it is session-uptime coverage: the dispatcher is a session-scoped cron, and the early-UTC weekday window (05:15 UTC = 07:15 CEST) has had no session running at fire time since 2026-08-13/14. Evening slots fired last night, so coverage exists later in the day.

findings.detail: Predicted last tick that chef-intraday would be cadence-suppressed at its 05:13 cron fire (last_fired 04:18:40 -> 56.3 min elapsed vs a 60-min policy floor). This tick's preflight reports suppressed_cadence:['chef-intraday'] — prediction held. The cron is '13 2-8 * * 1-5' (hourly) but the cadence floor is 60 min measured from actual last_fired, so any tick that runs even slightly late permanently ratchets the next fire out of its own cron window. CADENCE-GATE-LOCKS-HOURLY-CRON-TO-2H is confirmed live, not theoretical.

Upgraded from the carried LOW spawn-latency framing. .claude/skills/step-0-cowork/SKILL.md:36-44 (identical at .claude/skills/cycle-bootstrap/SKILL.md:59) derives TICK = current UTC HH:MM and looks up cycle-snapshot-<HH:MM>.json exactly, THEN applies a '>7 min old -> treat as absent' / '<=7 min -> use' freshness test. That test is dead code: an exact-minute filename is only findable during its own minute, when it is by construction <=60s old. Measured misses this session were all under one minute stale — an order of magnitude inside the tolerance the spec already grants. Fix: glob cycle-snapshot-[0-9]*.json, take newest by created_at, apply the EXISTING <=7 min check (which also makes the glob safe against the 14 prior-day residue files — do not ship the glob without it). Two call sites, same text.
findings.correction: Also retracting my own prediction method: I twice forecast hit/miss from seconds-left-in-the-minute at write time and was wrong both directions (12s margin HIT, 40s margin MISS).
